messages:
Jess Park: Heads up — product plans to sunset eu-central-1 in Q3. need an operator-friendly plan to evacuate tenants while honoring data residency constraints. who owns the runbook? :wave:
Matt Li: +1. do we have a migration flow that keeps EU-only tenants in-region? if not, we need a carve-out (export or private-host). :eyes:
Olivia Fernández: Legal confirmed a subset of customers are EU-only (contract clause). we can't move their data outside EU. they'll need either: (a) migrate to another EU region we keep, or (b) provide a managed offboard (S3 export into their VPC).
Ada (infra): For (a) we can relocate tenants to eu-west-2 (if capacity). runbook bits: mark tenant as "relocating", quiesce writes, snapshot, rsync -> target, swap DNS/proxy, verify. quick pseudo-commands:
```
# mark tenant
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/_internal/tenants/1234/state" -d '{"residency": "relocating", "target_region": "eu-west-2"}' 
# trigger snapshot + transfer
./scripts/tenant_transfer --tenant 1234 --to eu-west-2 --snapshot-id latest
```
Matt Li: Important: KV cache and session affinity. don't cutover until remote KV priming completes. suggest a priming job that replays recent hot prefixes. example:
```
POST /internal/cache/prime {"tenant_id":1234, "prefixes": ["/chat/", "/embed/"] }
```
Nia-Ops-Bot: scheduled-event: Maintenance window for eu-central-1 sunset proposal set for 2026-08-12T02:00Z. attendees: eng-runtime, eng-infra, legal, support. :calendar:
Jess Park: For EU-only customers that can't move, offer export bundle + proof of deletion play. we need checklist items for compliance: export hash, signed attestation, deletion ticket.
Olivia Fernández: On deletion: add a retention-lock step so infra waits for legal sign-off before the final wipe. also we must retain per-tenant audit logs for 90 days post-transfer as required by contracts.
Ada (infra): Operational safety notes:
- Create canary cohort (<=1% tenants) to validate data parity and perf in target region.
- Add a metric `residency.transfer.latency` and `residency.transfer.errors` (tag by tenant_id, target_region).
- Ensure alerting on mismatch counts: if rows_transferred != expected_rows -> stop.
Jess Park: Agree. telemetry continuity is critical — we must preserve token-level cost/latency breakdown across transfer so billing and SLOs are seamless. propose a short overlap window where both regions accept reads but only target accepts writes after cutover. :lock:
Matt Li: One caution: cross-region fallback and fallback policies must not violate residency. we need router-level rules: if a tenant has residency=EU_ONLY, do not fallback to non-EU tier ever. that logic must be in the proxy layer.
Ada (infra): Implementation sketch for proxy header: forward X-Tenant-Residency: EU_ONLY|RELOCATING|GLOBAL. proxy will: if EU_ONLY and target unavailable -> return 451 with guidance link. small snippet:
```
if tenant.residency == 'EU_ONLY' and !region.has_capacity():
  return 451, "Region unavailable — contact support or request migration"
```
Olivia Fernández: UX + support notes: update customer portal with migration status, ETA, and a 'request managed export' button. keep language simple.
Jess Park: Can someone volunteer to draft the runbook PR? include: pre-checks, canary plan, metric instrumentation (names above), rollback criteria, legal signoff stub, support play.
Ada (infra): I can start the runbook draft and the metric PR. will include the code snippets and a gating flag `tenant.transfer.ready`.
Matt Li: I'll put together the proxy guard and unit tests. will add policy to prevent accidental fallback.
Olivia Fernández: I'll draft the customer-facing text and coordinate with legal for the deletion attestation template.
Nia-Ops-Bot: reminder: create incident channel when we start the first canary transfer. suggested name: #sunset-eu-central-1-drain.
Jess Park: Perfect. TL;DR runbook checklist (for the PR):
- identify EU_ONLY tenants + opt-out list
- preflight capacity checks in target EU region
- canary cohort + transfer validation script
- KV cache priming and session affinity swap
- telemetry (residency.transfer.*) + billing continuity check
- legal attestation + retention lock for deletion
- fallback/proxy guard to block cross-border fallbacks
- customer portal status + support playbook
- rollback criteria and stop conditions

Jess Park: I'll open the runbook PR this afternoon and tag you all. :rocket:
Matt Li: :thumbsup:
Olivia Fernández: :heart:
Ada (infra): noted, will add tests and the metric dashboards to the PR.
